mapper.insert: INSERT INTO employee_management (user_id, employee_name, hourly_wage, total_hours_worked, last_reset_date) VALUES (#{userId}, #{employeeName}, #{hourlyWage}, #{totalHoursWorked}, #{lastResetDate})
mapper.select: SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, user_id AS userId, employee_name AS employeeName, hourly_wage AS hourlyWage, total_hours_worked AS totalHoursWorked, last_reset_date AS lastResetDate FROM employee_management

SELECT employee_id AS employeeId, user_id AS userId, employee_name AS employeeName, hourly_wage AS hourlyWage, total_hours_worked AS totalHoursWorked, last_reset_date AS lastResetDate FROM employee_management WHERE employee_name = #{employeeName}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO salary_records (employee_id, amount, payment_date) VALUES (#{employeeId}, #{amount}, #{paymentDate})
